categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Printed Circuit Board (PCB) manufacturing and Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS). PCB products serve applications in personal computers, network cards, storage devices, communication products, consumer electronics, automotive electronics including battery management systems for new energy vehicles, and other industrial applications. EMS services include mold making, injection molding, coating, SMT placement, and system assembly, focusing on substrates assembly for PCs, storage, communication, automotive, power tools, energy storage, smart living, industrial control, medical devices, and optoelectronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including development of low to ultra-low loss materials, thick copper processes, HDI technology for high-end notebook boards, plasma stripping, vacuum plugging, ceramic brushing, and copper thinning. EMS segment emphasizes automation and precision processes such as SMT placement for DDR5 DIMM connectors, laser welding, automated spring screw feeding and fastening, AOI with AI for inspection, multi-channel testing, and robotic automation. The company also develops proprietary software for production management and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global electronics manufacturers in personal computing, networking, storage, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial control, medical devices, and smart home sectors. The company serves both commercial and high-end markets such as gaming laptops, AI servers, electric vehicles, and smart city infrastructure. Major sales regions include Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with a focus on diversified end markets to mitigate risks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities across Taiwan, China (including Shenzhen, Chongqing, and Wuhu), Malaysia, Japan, and Hong Kong. Sales are primarily concentrated in Asia (about 89%), followed by the Americas (about 8%) and Europe (about 3%). The company is expanding capacity in Malaysia and China to support global supply chain diversification and customer demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing PCBs and providing EMS assembly services. It integrates upstream raw materials procurement from major suppliers and downstream assembly and testing services, offering vertically integrated solutions. The company also invests in automation and process optimization to enhance supply chain resilience and responsiveness.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value-added products such as automotive electronics, industrial control, smart home, energy storage, medical devices, and AI server boards. R&D focuses on advanced PCB materials (low/ultra-low loss), thick copper processes, HDI technology, and EMS automation technologies including AI inspection and robotic testing. The company emphasizes supply chain stability, global capacity expansion, and sustainability initiatives aligned with carbon neutrality and ESG principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of PCBs and provision of EMS manufacturing services. The company also earns income from related services such as mold making, coating, and assembly. Sales are made to corporate customers globally, with revenue recognized upon delivery of goods and services. The company maintains a diversified customer base to reduce concentration risk.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the PCB segment, main competitors include Taiwan-based firms such as Unimicron, Zhen Ding, and Kingboard, while in EMS, competitors include large contract manufacturers like Foxconn, Pegatron, and Wistron. The company ranks 34th globally among professional electronics manufacturers. It differentiates itself through vertical integration, advanced technology, quality certifications, and close collaboration with international customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$24.25 billion in 2022, with PCB accounting for about 64% and EMS about 36%. Net income attributable to the parent company was around NT$2.47 billion, with EPS of NT$5.24. The company has shown stable profitability despite a 12% revenue decline due to market softness. It maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets around NT$34 billion and equity of NT$18.3 billion, and continues to invest in capacity expansion and automation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrity, commitment, customer partnership, focus on core competencies, quality, and global operations. It offers high-quality, technologically advanced PCB and EMS solutions with strong R&D capabilities and vertical integration. Its value proposition includes flexible supply chain management, advanced manufacturing processes, and sustainability efforts to meet evolving customer needs in high-growth sectors like automotive electronics and AI servers.
